resolutionRationale: Manifest recursion over `dependencies` (workspace:/link:/file: specs) is authoritative: it is deterministic and matches what pnpm actually links at install time. Static import scanning is incomplete for this upstream because dsh discovers and loads plugins at runtime (plugin-manager, dsh.configTrees mounts), so import graphs silently omit runtime-reached packages; import scanning is retained only as a subset-verification pass (--verify-imports). devDependencies are excluded (build-only, never shipped).
